Fieldwork

Real fieldwork beats another framework.

FIELDWORK by Earth5R takes students out of the classroom and into their own neighbourhoods to study real problems with the community, with a mentor checking each finding. Evidence from the ground makes a better appendix.

Learn more at earth5r.org
jobs_ad_html: Fieldwork Want a case on your CV that is real? FIELDWORK by Earth5R is a mentored fellowship where school and university students work on a live Earth5R project near home, and every piece of work is verified. earth5r.org/fieldwork
